results.title: Beware Of A Single Point Of Failure | Mitigate Technology Risks
results.content: If your company has an in-house team, how familiar is each member of that team with other members’ tasks? If you use a Managed Service Provider, is knowledge about your company’s technology being shared across the team so that multiple technicians are familiar with your network? On any company team, it’s common for one person to be more knowledgeable about specific tasks than anyone else. The members of your IT team should actively cross-train on important tasks each month so a sudden departure doesn’t turn into a knowledge chasm. If it’s very difficult for your company to complete tasks or solve problems when a specific technician leaves for vacation, that’s a bad sign that you don’t have adequate knowledge sharing throughout the team. In addition to helping your company better manage risk and avoid a single point of failure, this will help you to ensure that your employees can truly rest and recover without panicking about technical meltdowns when they’re on vacation!
